title: Orchid Therapeutics POC assurance pocket guide
content:
Purpose: compact, field-ready summary of Orchid Therapeutics POC infosec deliverables, the evidence we will hand over, and immediate open questions. Target audience: SEs running the POC, Customer Security reviewers, and the internal audit prep owner.

Quick context:
- Customer: Orchid Therapeutics (clinical data processing, regulated)
- POC scope: Private deployment (VPC), dedicated inference for batch de-identification + embeddings, audit trail for model access and outputs.
- Timeline: POC kickoff 2025-09-05, final blind evidence handoff planned 2025-10-10.

Minimum evidence bundle (what we will deliver):
1) Architecture artefacts
   - network diagram (orchid_network_diagram_v1.pdf) showing VPC, peering, subnets, NAT, customer firewall rules.
   - component map (orchid_components_v1.svg) with runtime placements (hosted vs dedicated pool).
2) Access & identity
   - IAM roles inventory (orchid_iam_inventory_2025-09.csv) with least-privilege rationale notes.
   - sample STS assertion and audit log snippet (sts_assertion_sample.txt, audit_log_sample_2025-09.csv).
3) Data controls
   - S3 bucket policy and lifecycle (orchid_s3_policy.json).
   - de-id pipeline design doc and test vector results (deid_pipeline_results.pdf).
4) Crypto & key management
   - KMS integration notes and CMK policy excerpt (kms_integration_notes.txt).
5) Runtime & configuration
   - Dedicated node config (dedicated_config.yml), kernel/quantization profile used for the POC.
   - Model versioning snapshot (model_repository_snapshot.txt).
6) Observability & retention
   - Sample tracing trace-id sequence and latency histogram (trace_sample_0918.txt).
   - Logs retention policy excerpt (logs_retention_policy.pdf).
7) Test evidence for controls
   - Pen-test quick-check checklist and results (pentest_quickcheck_2025-09.pdf).
   - Vulnerability scan summary (vulnscan_summary_2025-09.csv).

Owners and delivery commitments:
- Priya Desai: compile architecture artefacts + S3 policy (due 2025-09-20).
- Marcus Liu: IAM inventory + sample STS/audit snippets (due 2025-09-22).
- Evan Park: KMS notes + dedicated_config.yml + model snapshot (due 2025-09-26).
- Ruth Chen: de-id pipeline tests and de-identification report (due 2025-09-28).

Open questions / blockers (action items):
- Q1: Customer wants proof of HSM-backed key usage for private deployments. Do we provide a mock HSM policy excerpt or actual HSM binding? Owner: Evan. Status: investigating partner HSM options.
- Q2: Orchid's compliance team asked for full IAM change history for the last 12 months. We only have logs retained for 90 days by default. Action: request extended retention export; SRE contact: @sre-oncall.
- Q3: Clarify whether PII persists in intermediate KV cache for inference. Action: write a short note about KV cache retention and available controls (cache eviction, encryption at rest). Owner: Priya.

Customer workshop notes (2025-09-15 session):
- They emphasized deterministic purging and documented evidence of deletion for regulated workflows.
- Requested a short runbook for incident response that maps Redwood roles to Orchid contacts. Need to produce by 2025-09-30.
- Performance vs retention tradeoff: they will accept 24h trace retention for POC but need assurances for Prod.

Draft handoff checklist (to attach to final bundle):
- [ ] All artifacts present and named per manifest
- [ ] Evidence files hashed (sha256) and index included
- [ ] Redaction applied where customer asked (see deid notes)
- [ ] Owner signoff recorded (email thread or Doc signature)
- [ ] Confluence page updated with final links

Notes to SEs (quick tips):
- When exporting audit logs, include event_time and actor fields; avoid full token dumps.
- For demo runs, use synthetic PHI-like vectors that match structure but contain no real patient data.
- If customer asks about private control plane, point them to the "Private deployment: control plane responsibilities" confluence excerpt (linked artifacts above).

Appendix: quick links and references
- Confluence: ORCHID-POC-2025 (see linked_artifacts)
- Jira: JIRA-9876 (task for extended retention)
- Infra PR: infra PR 4321 (dedicated node config prototype)

Status summary (as of last_modified):
- Majority of artifacts drafted: architecture, IAM inventory, dedicated config.
- Pending items: HSM binding decision, extended log export, IR runbook finalization.

Action today: compile final manifest, run sha256 on listed files, and ping Orchid security to confirm acceptance of the 24h trace retention for POC.

---
This is intentionally concise; keep incremental notes here as you produce artifacts. If you add a new evidence file, append filename + short description + owner + date to this doc so we can maintain the single-source-of-truth for the handoff bundle.
